Hi Suzanne,

I’m so excited to have you on The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge! Below is a quick primer with background, focus areas, and sample questions to help guide our conversation. Nothing is scripted — the goal is a casual, engaging chat that highlights your story, your philosophy, and the unique role BlissCare plays in aesthetics and beyond.

👩‍💼 About Suzanne
Career: Nurse for 33+ years, beginning as a plastic surgery nurse alongside her husband, a plastic surgeon.

Experience: Built and managed a surgery center, oversaw emergency services, and moved into business development.

Current Role: VP of Business Development & Sales at BlissCare, a company providing downside risk protection for cash-pay procedures across 17+ specialties.

Personal Connection: Passionate about health, wellness, and hormone optimization — she is living proof of the benefits of bioidentical hormone therapy and functional care.

Mission: Protect surgeons and patients financially, while elevating trust and transparency in the surgical process.

🎯 Focus Areas for the Podcast
Suzanne’s journey from bedside nursing to leadership and business development.

How BlissCare helps surgeons manage complications for cash-pay procedures.

The financial and emotional relief it provides both practices and patients.

Trends in plastics, aesthetics, and bundled care (knees, hips, bariatrics, etc.).

Suzanne’s personal passion for health and hormone replacement therapy.

Insights into navigating conferences, building surgeon relationships, and overcoming barriers at the front desk.

❓ Sample Questions
You’ve had such a wide-ranging career — from plastic surgery nurse to VP at BlissCare. What inspired your shift into business development?

For those who aren’t familiar, what exactly is “downside risk protection,” and why is it becoming so critical for aesthetic and surgical practices?

You’ve worked closely with surgeons and practice managers. What do you see as the biggest challenges they face financially when it comes to complications?

How does BlissCare differ from other protection or insurance products in the industry?

You’ve mentioned your own wellness journey with hormone/health optimization. How has that shaped your perspective on longevity and patient care?

What advice would you give to practice owners who want to protect their business while still prioritizing patient trust?

Looking ahead, where do you see risk protection and bundled care heading in the next 5–10 years?
